name: Swamp of Sorrows
_terrain: A 3.3.5 zone Turtle changed lightly: Sorrowguard Keep (a new Alliance keep in the north-west, area 5075) and its garrison's quests, the draenei exiles of Sanv K'la, and other new NPCs and quests. The 3.3.5 zone, its NPCs and quests stay; Turtle's additions are merged in.
_merge_region: own=changed: only Swamp chunks Turtle reshaped or gave a new subzone (Sorrowguard Keep on 36_51, four chunks of 38_50). reshaped_skip_zones: Redridge (Turtle's Redwall Keep), the Blasted Lands, Burning Steppes, Stranglethorn, Duskwood - their Turtle ground belongs to their own zones. take_new_wmos: the keep's buildings on unchanged ground. Deadwind Pass is not skipped: Turtle reshaped the mountainside behind the keep across that border (16 chunks, up to 53 yd), taken with the keep (they keep their 3.3.5 area).
_exclude_creatures: Turtle systems: the training dummies, the rented horses and riding wolves (rented_mount), Swampwalker Krug (Turtle's Survival trainer). Kor'gan 60607 (C++ npc_korgan; his 'Depths of Karazhan' chain leads into Turtle's Karazhan Crypts, not ported). Akh Z'ador <Riftmaster> 61987 (his quest follows Kas'tal's chain in the Blasted Lands, not ported). The two expedition camps in the south-east - Grungi 60403 (Alliance) and Re'than 60410 with Tulu and the fallen warriors/soldiers 60414-60418 (Horde) - and the four cultists 60404-60407 they send players after: the camps are the middle of the level-60 'Uldum' chains of High Explorer Magellas and Sage Truthseeker, whose earlier steps are in Un'Goro and the Barrens and whose end is a scripted event at the Uldum pedestal. The Boulderclaw tunnelers 60838-60842 and Gorlush the Trampler 60844: they fill the cave under the south-east, where 3.3.5 has its Nethergarde miners; they belong to Turtle's Nethergarde rework ('The Garrison Armory Disaster', Blasted Lands) and wait for a Blasted Lands port.
_exclude_gameobjects: 2010892 Garrison Supply Cache: it only holds the item of 'Recovering Armory Supplies' (40429, Blasted Lands, not ported). 2020095 Gemstone Deposit: the five in this zone are in the Nethergarde mine (see exclude_creatures).
_exclude_quests: 40104/40105 and 40112/40113: the expedition camps (see exclude_creatures). 40304-40310: Kor'gan's Karazhan Crypts chain. 41296 The Collector (needs Turtle's Jewelcrafting) and 41299 (follows 41298 in the Blasted Lands). 41326-41328: Kas'tal's chain (Blasted Lands, not ported) and Akh Z'ador <Riftmaster>. 41922 Homecoming (from Elder Krasheen at Turtle's Moonwhisper Coast, not ported).
_extra_gameobject_spawns: The Aged Wooden Chest in the Scarlet Monastery Library (The Orb of Kaladus, 40233).
